data.one_liner: Scoped dependency injection library for Flutter, independent of state management solutions
data.what_it_does: Disco provides a way to declare providers that are scoped to a widget tree. The state is created and disposed within a ProviderScope, keeping it local and testable.
use_when: Need multiple providers of the same type without wrapper types
Want local state that is automatically disposed with the widget
Prefer a simple API that works with any state management library
avoid_when: Require compile‑time safety for provider lookup
Need built‑in reactivity methods like watch or listen
strengths: Supports multiple providers of the same type
Lifecycle tied to widget tree, no global scope
Very simple API, works with any state‑management solution
weaknesses: No built‑in reactivity; must use external listeners
Runtime error if provider not found
No compile‑time safety for provider lookup

alternatives.name: provider
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a simple, widget‑tree scoped DI without multiple same‑type providers

alternatives.name: riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need compile‑time safety and built‑in reactivity
